description:
Prices a verified term life estimate (first call) and returns it (later calls).

    Returns the best monthly premium, how many carriers were compared, and up to 5 options with
    monthly premium, AM Best rating and whether an exam is needed. Carrier names are shared by the
    agent. Show the notice with the prices: estimates, not offers; final rates depend on underwriting.
    To apply, call request_agent with the quote_id.
name: get_life_quotes
title: Get term life insurance estimates
